display.purpose: Hero titles and campaign-scale statements; scale creates authority.

label.purpose: Dates, route metadata, status, and real calibration notes.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Short color and border transitions for interactive states.

components.name: Primary Signal Button
components.description: The active campaign action: compact, square, and unmistakable.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b6ff00; color: #080908; border: 1px solid #b6ff00; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; font: 600 0.75rem/1.3 'Fira Code', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f3f1e8; border-color: #f3f1e8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6ff00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Control
components.description: A secondary route that stays visible without competing with the signal action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #f3f1e8; border: 1px solid #383a35; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.3 'Fira Code', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #b6ff00; color: #b6ff00; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b6ff00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Campaign Navigation
components.description: A compact top navigation bar with precise active-state signaling.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; background: #080908; border-bottom: 1px solid #383a35; padding: 12px 16px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.3 'Fira Code', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { color: #deddd4; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { color: #b6ff00; }

components.name: Halftone Field
components.description: A bounded calibration texture for hero or negative-space zones.
components.css: .ds-halftone { width: 240px; height: 160px; background-color: #b6ff00; background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #050505 1.5px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: 14px 14px; }

narrative.overview:
Macoaure is a personal blog and resume treated like a cinematic campaign site: bold, atmospheric, editorial, and engineered rather than decorated. The site should feel like a transmission from a speculative world, translated into a readable personal archive.

The visual language is premium industrial science fiction with full-bleed cinematic energy: large display typography, hard black fields, warm bone-white type, saturated acid-lime action color, and compact chapter labels. Fira Code remains the technical metadata voice; Barlow Condensed carries campaign-scale headlines.

The result should be mysterious without becoming dystopian, technical without becoming noisy, and expressive without sacrificing the reading experience.
keyCharacteristics: Deep charcoal canvas with warm bone-white type and structural gray rules.
Acid-lime used for calls to action, active links, and campaign markers.
Barlow Condensed display headlines paired with Fira Code technical metadata.
Large cinematic chapters, asymmetric grids, and compact uppercase labels.
Halftone fields used as controlled graphic texture, never as wallpaper.
Flat engineered surfaces with hard borders and tonal layers instead of decorative shadows.

rules.name: The Campaign Signal Rule
rules.body: Acid-lime marks the next action or the active chapter. It should never become a general-purpose background color.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed owns the campaign voice; Fira Code owns the technical voice. Do not introduce another display face.

rules.name: The Flat Campaign Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A state change may brighten a border or fill an action field, but it should not introduce a generic shadow or glow.

dos: Do use black, warm bone, structural gray, muted bone, and acid-lime as the everyday palette.
Do use Barlow Condensed for campaign-scale headings and Fira Code for technical detail.
Do build hierarchy with scale, alignment, and whitespace before adding ornament.
Do use technical labels only when they carry real information.
Do keep halftone geometry sparse, regular, and structurally anchored.
Do preserve readable body copy and accessible contrast.
donts: Don't use generic cyberpunk neon, rainbow gradients, or glowing holographic panels.
Don't add fantasy mechanisms, military camouflage, excessive greebles, or meaningless symbols.
Don't fill every surface with halftone noise or microcopy.
Don't use decorative shadows, rounded software-dashboard cards, or pill controls.
Don't replace real content with fictional specifications or random serial numbers.
Don't let the industrial fiction overpower the blog and resume's usefulness.
